nodes.name: eventBuilders.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file that re-exports the pure SessionEvent factory functions (make*, create*) and the ErrorEventOptions type from eventFactories.ts, giving adapters a single stable import point.

nodes.name: eventFactories.ts
nodes.summary: Defines pure constructor functions for every SessionEvent variant (assistant message, thinking, tool call/result, summary, error, rate-limit hint, synthetic user event) used by all session adapters to build normalized event objects.

nodes.name: streamTextAccumulator.ts
nodes.summary: Implements incremental merge logic for streamed assistant text deltas, using a KMP-style prefix table to detect suffix/prefix overlap and avoid duplicating already-rendered content.

nodes.name: streamingParsers.ts
nodes.summary: Provides parsers for partial/streamed tool-call JSON arguments and helpers for handling <think>...</think> reasoning tags embedded in streamed agent text.

nodes.name: subagentTracking.ts
nodes.summary: Utilities for detecting subagent-spawning tool calls and locating the active subagent call and its parent event within a session's event list.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Canonical shared type definitions (AgentMessage, StreamingErrorCode, and related agent event shapes) used across all session adapters, mirroring the Rust backend's streaming error enum.

nodes.name: externalHistoryAutoRefresh.ts
nodes.summary: React hook that periodically polls and refreshes an imported (external) history session's transcript when the underlying source file's signature changes.

nodes.name: nativeTranscriptReconcile.ts
nodes.summary: Tracks which sessions use a native (CLI-produced) transcript source and schedules periodic reconciliation passes that merge freshly written transcript lines into the in-memory event store.

nodes.name: sessionChannelActivity.ts
nodes.summary: Tracks last-activity timestamps per session's IPC channel, used elsewhere to detect stalled or idle channels.

nodes.name: sessionSwitchEffectRunner.ts
nodes.summary: Coordinates the side effects of a React session-switch effect: resets prior switch state, disposes the old event handler, resolves the session's adapter, and hands off to the switch orchestrator (or the no-adapter loader).

nodes.name: sessionSwitchOrchestrator.ts
nodes.summary: Orchestrates loading a session's history on switch: checks the in-memory event-store cache, dispatches to cache-hit/cache-miss/Cursor-IDE-specific paths, and reconciles in-flight runs and pending plan approvals.

nodes.name: sessionSyncChannel.ts
nodes.summary: Routes a raw session IPC channel event through schema validation and adapter-specific event handling, updating channel activity tracking.

nodes.name: makeAssistantEvent
nodes.summary: Constructs a normalized assistant-message SessionEvent, stripping <think> tags from streamed content before returning the event.

nodes.name: makeThinkingEvent
nodes.summary: Constructs a normalized thinking/reasoning SessionEvent for an agent's internal reasoning stream.

nodes.name: makeToolCallEvent
nodes.summary: Constructs a tool-call SessionEvent, resolving display metadata and interactive-tool flags for the invoked tool.

nodes.name: makeToolResultEvent
nodes.summary: Constructs a tool-result SessionEvent that pairs a completed tool invocation with its result content.

nodes.name: makeSummaryEvent
nodes.summary: Constructs a turn-summary SessionEvent aggregating tool call counts and wall-clock time for a completed agent turn.

nodes.name: makeErrorEvent
nodes.summary: Constructs an error SessionEvent from either a raw error value or explicit error options, normalizing the event id.

nodes.name: makeRateLimitHintEvent
nodes.summary: Constructs a rate-limit hint SessionEvent surfaced to the UI when a provider signals throttling.

nodes.name: mintTurnIntentId
nodes.summary: Generates a unique identifier for a new turn intent.

nodes.name: createSyntheticUserEvent
nodes.summary: Constructs a synthetic user SessionEvent used to represent locally-originated prompts before backend confirmation.

nodes.name: mergeStreamingText
nodes.summary: Merges an incoming text delta into accumulated streaming content, deduplicating overlapping suffix/prefix runs.

nodes.name: findSuffixPrefixOverlap
nodes.summary: Finds the longest overlap between the end of the current buffer and the start of incoming text using a KMP-style search.

nodes.name: buildPrefixTable
nodes.summary: Builds the KMP partial-match (failure function) table used to accelerate suffix/prefix overlap detection.

nodes.name: buildToolArgsFromParsed
nodes.summary: Normalizes a parsed JSON value into the tool-call argument record shape expected by downstream handlers.

nodes.name: parsePartialToolArgs
nodes.summary: Best-effort parses incomplete/streaming JSON tool-call arguments, tolerating truncated input mid-stream.

nodes.name: isShellTool
nodes.summary: Checks whether a tool name refers to a shell/exec-style tool.

nodes.name: stripThinkTags
nodes.summary: Removes <think> reasoning blocks from message content before it is shown as assistant output.

nodes.name: extractThinkContent
nodes.summary: Extracts the raw contents of <think> reasoning tags from a message for separate rendering.

nodes.name: isSubagentSpawningTool
nodes.summary: Determines whether a tool name is one of the tools known to spawn a subagent session.

nodes.name: findActiveSubagentCallIndex
nodes.summary: Scans a session's events to find the index of the currently active (unresolved) subagent-spawning tool call.

nodes.name: findSubagentParentEventId
nodes.summary: Finds the parent event id that spawned a given subagent coding session.

nodes.name: capStreamContent
nodes.summary: Truncates streamed text content to a maximum length to bound memory and render cost.

nodes.name: transcriptChanged
nodes.summary: Compares a freshly computed transcript signature against the last remembered one to detect whether the external transcript file changed.

nodes.name: refreshImportedHistorySession
nodes.summary: Reloads an imported-history session's events when its source transcript has changed on disk.

nodes.name: useExternalHistoryAutoRefresh
nodes.summary: Hook that sets up an interval to auto-refresh the active imported-history session at a configurable frequency.

nodes.name: registerSessionTranscriptSource
nodes.summary: Records which transcript source (native vs synthetic) a given session uses.

nodes.name: isNativeTranscriptSession
nodes.summary: Checks whether a session's transcript originates from the native CLI process rather than synthesized events.

nodes.name: scheduleNativeTranscriptReconcile
nodes.summary: Schedules a recurring reconciliation loop that re-reads a native CLI session's transcript and merges new content into the store.

nodes.name: noteSessionChannelActivity
nodes.summary: Records the current time as the last activity timestamp for a session's channel.

nodes.name: msSinceSessionChannelActivity
nodes.summary: Computes milliseconds elapsed since a session's channel last reported activity.

nodes.name: clearSessionChannelActivity
nodes.summary: Clears the recorded activity timestamp for a session's channel.

nodes.name: runSessionSwitchEffect
nodes.summary: Runs the full session-switch side-effect sequence for a newly active session, wiring up its adapter, event handler, and switch orchestrator, and returning a cleanup function.

nodes.name: resetEmptySessionRefs
nodes.summary: Resets the switch-tracking refs when transitioning to a null/idle session.

nodes.name: runSessionSwitchOrchestrator
nodes.summary: Entry point that checks the event-store cache for a session switch and dispatches to the cache-hit or cache-miss handling path, reporting failures via the load-error action.

nodes.name: handleCacheHit
nodes.summary: Handles a cache-hit session switch: applies post-load metadata, falls back to persisted history if the round-window is empty, and reconciles in-flight runs and pending plan approvals.

nodes.name: handleCursorIdeCacheHit
nodes.summary: Handles the Cursor-IDE-specific cache-hit path, comparing composer update timestamps to decide whether cached events are still fresh or need a full reload.

nodes.name: handleCacheMiss
nodes.summary: Handles a cache-miss session switch by loading persisted (or in-flight) history from scratch and hydrating the event store before dispatch.

nodes.name: routeSessionChannelEvent
nodes.summary: Validates and dispatches a raw session channel message to the active event handler, recording channel activity.
